breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification removes the erroneous instruction to treat the internal torque as a single algebraic sum over the full shaft length. Instead, it correctly states that the internal torque is 'constructed for each segment,' the shear stress is 'computed for each segment,' and the twist is found by 'summing the twist of each segment' — all consistent with the correct piecewise constant torque approach required by the ground truth.
